captions: Tab. 11.11 Zusammenstellung der Eingabedaten für die Konditionierung radioaktiver Abfälle im Zwischenlager.
reason: Tab. 11.11 (p.309) is titled 'input data for the CONDITIONING of radioactive waste in the interim storage facility (Zwischenlager)' — literally this dataset, 'Radioactive waste, in interim storage conditioning', per m3. Tab. 11.7-11.10 on p.308-309 are the infrastructure and operation of the interim store itself (a different, upstream dataset) and are only inside the range because they adjoin; p.310 is included in case Tab. 11.11 runs on.
